name: mmRAG
description: mmRAG is a modular benchmark for evaluating multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation systems across text, tables, and knowledge graphs. It integrates queries from six diverse QA datasets and provides granular evaluation of retrieval accuracy and query routing beyond end-to-end generation quality.
reputation: A very recent benchmark proposal that is still emerging in the multimodal RAG literature and has limited community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on modular evaluation of RAG components; uses standard IR procedures for relevance annotation.
